data.title: Van driver caught with 4m meth pills
data.description: AMNAT CHAROEN - Police seized 4 million methamphetamine pills worth an estimated 200 million baht and arrested a van driver following a late-night chase in this northeastern province.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ubaid Hussain targets Qatar, Johan Ghazali after US$100,000 contract win
data.description: Ubaid Hussain has set his sights on ONE Championship’s 2027 return to Qatar after finally securing a US$100,000 main-roster contract – with Johan Ghazali already emerging as a potential future rival.

data.title: Man with knife arrested at school earlier drank pig's blood and beer
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Police were called to arrest a man who was acting weirdly in a school yard after earlier drinking pig's blood and beer, in Khon Buri district.

data.title: Gunmen storm Pattani department store, set off bombs
data.description: PATTANI - Armed insurgents stormed into a big department store in Pattani on Saturday evening, forcing customers and employees to leave before detonating three bombs.

data.title: Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories
data.description: DHUNGE (NEPAL) - Days after a wall of water and debris ripped through Nepal, Shanti Lamichhane sat on a fruit crate in the dirt where her village once stood, staring at what remained of her home.

data.title: Rescuers dig into tunnel as missing toll from Nepal, China flood nears 3,000
data.description: BIDUR (NEPAL) - Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday to find thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages.

data.title: Australian right-wing party steals Labor seat in Perth
data.description: SYDNEY - The ⁠right-wing One Nation ⁠party has won a seat ​in a state parliament long held by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's centre-left ​Labor Party, continuing a surge that ‌recently gained the populist group its first seat in the national lower house of parliament.

data.title: Heavy rain forecast over most of Thailand
data.description: The Meteorological Department forecast is for heavy rain in western parts of the North, the Central Plain, the upper and eastern parts of the Northeast and the East from Sunday to Wednesday.

data.title: Killing of Palestinian children and teens by Israel surges in West Bank
data.description: RAMALLAH (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Alia al-Hallaq's son Mohammed was nine when he was killed by an Israeli army bullet last October, but the Palestinian homemaker still speaks of herself as a mother of five, not four.

data.title: Nepal-China floods disaster: Latest developments
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - The number of people missing in the catastrophic flood that sliced through the border area between Nepal and Tibet neared 3,000 on Sunday, as rescuers scoured deep, leg-sucking mud for survivors.

data.title: Venezuelans view US oil deal with doubt, hope
data.description: CARACAS - Venezuelans expressed doubt and suspicion on Saturday over a new deal enabling the United States to exploit the country's oil reserves, an arrangement that nevertheless raises hopes for economic recovery after years of crisis.

data.title: Educators keep 9/11 memory alive for next generation, 25 years on
data.description: NEW YORK - When 17-year-old student Max Avena visited the site of New York's fallen Twin Towers, hearing the first-hand accounts of survivors of the deadliest attacks on US soil left him "speechless."

data.title: Lisa blends Muay Thai and a tuk-tuk in SaWaDiKa teaser
data.description: SaWaDiKa, named after the Thai greeting, arrives at 7am in Thailand on September 4 before Lisa’s six-track PRESS PLAY EP lands on October 23.

data.title: NASA's Roman telescope to launch on cosmic mapping mission
data.description: WASHINGTON - NASA plans to launch its new flagship space telescope on Sunday, embarking on a multi-year mission to create an unprecedented map of the cosmos and shed light on some of the biggest mysteries in physics.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 30

data.title: Counterfeit goods cost the economy B809m in seven months
data.description: <p>Intellectual property violations caused more than 809 million baht in economic losses in the first seven months of this year, the Department of Intellectual Property said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Pattaya art festival now live
data.description: CHON BURI: Pattaya has launched its first sand art festival, combining sculptures, light, sound and technology to create a new landmark for tourists.

data.title: Sarut in charge after solid day at Bangkok Open
data.description: <p>Sarut Vongchaisit fired an eight-under-par 62 to take the third-round lead at the three-million-baht Singha Bangkok Open at Bangkok Golf Club in Pathum Thani yesterday.</p>

data.title: Phuket beach site ordered cleared
data.description: PHUKET: Thalang district has enforced a Supreme Court ruling over more than five rai of disputed land at Bang Tao beach, where 16 restaurants were built.

data.title: The missing in Nepal-Tibet flash floods
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Nearly 3,000 people were still missing on Sunday with 682 confirmed dead after flash floods and landslides hit the Nepal-Tibet border.

data.title: US deports right-wing provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported to his home country of Britain, the US government said Saturday.

data.title: Locals eye Mon Bridge repair
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Sangkhlaburi district is planning a major repair of the Mon Bridge after heavy rain damaged parts of the structure. The work is expected to cost 40-50 million baht.

data.title: Skywalk to complete Victory Monument loop in October
data.description: <p>Bangkok will open the first phase of the Rajavithi Skywalk in early October, linking BTS Victory Monument station with existing walkways around the landmark.</p>

data.title: Sprinters strike gold at Track Asia Cup despite rain-shortened finals
data.description: Thailand's men's team sprint squad claimed gold at the Track Asia Cup 2026 yesterday, posting the fastest qualifying time before a violent downpour forced officials to abandon the final and decide medals on qualification times alone.

data.title: 'Raising the Game': Thai League 1 launches 30th anniversary season
data.description: Thailand's top football division marked three decades of existence on Friday, unveiling the 2026-27 Thai League season under the slogan "Raising the Game" as it seeks to push the domestic game closer to international standards.

data.title: Spikers earn  shot at 2028  Games spot
data.description: Thailand will have an opportunity to fight for an Olympic berth after booking their berth in the final of the 2026 AVC Women's Volleyball Asian Championship in Tianjin on Saturday.

data.title: NE faces drought as South braces for floods
data.description: <p>A prolonged dry spell linked to the incoming "super El Ni&ntilde;o" is reducing water supplies in Nakhon Ratchasima province, as Songkhla province in the South prepares for possible flooding.</p>

data.title: Security net changes spur fears
data.description: <p>Three key economic agencies have urged the Labour Ministry to review plans to extend Section 33 of the Social Security Act to additional categories of workers, citing concerns over the financial impact on workers, employers and the state.</p>

data.title: Netanyahu condemns settler attack in flashpoint West Bank village
data.description: QUSRA (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Dozens of Israeli settlers attacked the Palestinian village of Qusra in the northern occupied West Bank on Saturday after nearly three weeks of tension in the area, drawing rare condemnation from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
